answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must acquire and lock a fresh pigment per fake identity, escalating cost linearly with each clone. Each agent stakes a unique pigment token minted at registration, binding identity to a scarce on-chain resource. A shared atlas maps every stake to a verified knoll of reputation history, so duplicate or thin histories are flagged and rejected by peers during attestation. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
